Návrh schodiště - Prostorové požadavky na schodiště a schodišťový prostor, vztah vnitřního schodiště k ostatním konstrukcím budovy, konstrukční prvky schodiště. Zásady pro návrh schodiště a zábradlí, výpočty. (dotace 2/0)

HC 2 – ukázky jednotlivých konstrukcí pozemních staveb na konkrétních rozestavěných stavbách (dotace 0/8)

cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Naučit se navrhovat základní konstrukce pozemního stavitelství, především nosné konstrukce a prvky. Znalost hlavních pojmů z oblasti stavebnictví, normativů a stavební legislativy. Dodržovat nezbytné zásady technického kreslení a zobrazování stavebních konstrukcí. Výstupem je potom praktické zpracování výkresové dokumentace pozemní stavby menšího rozsahu.

Basic building systems, one and multi-storey buildings, hall constructions (allowance 2/0)

Property classification into individual building components and familiarization with their properties. Classification uniform of the building object and construction works of the manufacturer character. Building environment technology. (allowance 2/0)
Foundation structures - distribution, load determination and approximate calculation of foundations, foundation of buildings with cellar and basementless. (allowance 2/0)
Waterproofing of the substructure. (allowance 2/0)
Procedure for height and position placement of the building, solution of entrances to the building. Situation, land fencing. (allowance 2/0)
Vertical load-bearing structures, partitions. (allowance 2/0)
Hole fillings. Smokestacks and smoke-flues. (allowance 2/0)
Horizontal load-bearing structures - subfloor structures. (allowance 2/0)
Horizontal load-bearing structures – lintel. Overhanging construction and receding structures, ceillings. (allowance 2/0)
Structures connecting different height levels: ramps, stairs, ladders, steps and elevators. Classification, design solutions, spatial connections. (allowance 2/0)

Staircase design - space requirements for the staircase and stairwell, the relationship of the internal staircase to other building structures, structural elements of the staircase. Principles for the design of stairs and railings, calculations (allowance 2/0)

Methods of displaying, drawing and dimensioning individual building components and units: Drawing excavations, foundations, vertical and horizontal structures, chimneys, stairs, ramps, joinery products, fixtures, sections, views, details, situations, etc. Spatial representations of architectural space. (allowance 0/24)
HC 1 – excursion to the buildings under construction - focus on excavations, foundations, substructures, waterproofing. (allowance 0/8)
HC 2 - examples of individual constructions of buildings on specific constructions (allowance 0/8)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To learn how to propose and judge the basic structures of the building construction. Knowledge of basic terms from the field of building industries and building legislature. Follow the necessary of the principles of technical drawing and the display of building constructions under the valid standards. The output is then the practical processing of the simple building construction drawing documentation.
